medicina.titulo: Deep learning model using ECGs during sleep studies can predict cardiovascular outcomes
medicina.resumo: A research team supported by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) has found that electrocardiograms (ECGs) administered during sleep and paired with sleep stage information can be used to determine the risk of future adverse cardiac events. The study, which used a deep learning approach, suggests that using ECGs to predict which patients have a greater risk of poor heart-related outcomes could help guide clinical decision-making. The findings were published in the journal SLEEP.

medicina.titulo: Radiation exposure linked to pulmonary hypertension after lung cancer treatment
medicina.resumo: Lung cancer patients undergoing radiation treatment may be at higher risk of developing pulmonary hypertension, a type of high blood pressure that affects the arteries that carry blood from the right side of the heart to the lungs. Over time, that heightened pressure can lead to right-sided heart failure.

medicina.titulo: A healthy Nordic diet may help you to live longer, but liver benefits remain unclear
medicina.resumo: In general, people who eat a healthy diet give themselves a significantly better chance of avoiding some major diseases than those who don't. The Nordic diet, also known as a northern version of the Mediterranean diet, is a healthy, sustainable way of eating based on traditional foods of countries like Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland. It includes plant foods and berries, whole grains, low-fat dairy products and fatty fish.

biologia.titulo: Why some young ants start hunting and caring for others early
biologia.resumo: Some insects, including honeybees and ants, live in highly organized colonies where individuals take on specific roles. In many ant societies, young adult workers typically care for developing young inside the nest before beginning to forage, or search for food, outside it. Some ant species, however, start hunting for food as soon as they reach adulthood, without undergoing a transition period.

biologia.titulo: Tiny marine microbe sheds new light on how little genetic machinery a cell needs to survive
biologia.resumo: Scientists have discovered a previously unknown microorganism that has the smallest genome ever found and may be able to replicate and express its own genetic information.

biologia.titulo: Against the odds: Why some ecosystems thrive
biologia.resumo: From coral reefs in Papua New Guinea to chimpanzees in West Africa, grizzly bears in Canada and albatross colonies off Tasmania, some ecosystems are thriving despite climate change, habitat loss and other environmental pressures.

biologia.titulo: Review Ford Maverick Lariat Hybrid: uma picape que “pensa” como carro
biologia.resumo: A Ford Maverick Lariat Hybrid é uma picape que foge de algumas das receitas mais tradicionais do segmento. Em vez de apostar exclusivamente em força bruta, grande capacidade de carga ou motor diesel, ela combina um motor 2.5 a gasolina de ciclo Atkinson com um propulsor elétrico , entregando uma experiência que a aproxima bastante das vivenciadas em um carro de passeio . Essa característica aparece logo nos primeiros quilômetros. A Maverick tem dimensões de picape , posição de dirigir elevada e caçamba, mas seu comportamento dinâmico , a suspensão traseira independente e a resposta do conjunto híbrido fazem com que ela seja bastante diferente de uma caminhonete convencional . É uma picape que foi pensada para o uso cotidiano , inclusive dentro da cidade. Na linha 2026, a Ford ainda reforçou essa proposta com tração integral AWD, 194 cv de potência combinada, novos recursos de assistência ao motorista e uma lista generosa de equipamentos . astrofisica.titulo: Discovery marks the first detection of variable water clouds outside of the solar system
astrofisica.resumo: A Jupiter-sized world just 7.5 light-years away is cloudy, chemically complex and, it turns out, more like home than anyone expected. Using the James Webb Space Telescope, Brittany Miles, assistant astronomer at the University of Arizona's Steward Observatory, led a team that spent 11 hours staring at WISE 0855, the coldest known brown dwarf, collecting a spectrum of its light every 15 minutes.

astrofisica.titulo: SPHEREx spots menagerie of brown dwarfs with atmospheric water and methane
astrofisica.resumo: NASA's SPHEREx (Spectro-Photometer for the History of the universe, Epoch of Reionization, and ices Explorer) space telescope is shedding light on brown dwarfs, celestial objects that blur the line between stars and exoplanets. New findings published in The Astrophysical Journal show that these dark and cloudy worlds have chemically rich atmospheres not unlike the giant planets in our own solar system.

quantica.titulo: Hybrid quantum computer observes foundational quantum effect in a new setting
quantica.resumo: Physicists in the Department of Physics at the University of Oxford have used a hybrid quantum computer, made up of qubits and quantum oscillators, to observe the Aharonov–Bohm effect in a quantum simulation. The effect is a quantum phenomenon in which a particle can acquire a measurable phase by traveling around a magnetic flux, even though it never passes through a region where a magnetic field is present.

The acceleration is driven by a fundamental shift in how modern AI models are built and scaled. As the models have become much larger and more complex, they are computationally more demanding because they contain more parameters and require more calculations. To meet the demands of scaling deep neural networks, the industry is increasingly developing AI chips that are designed for specific tasks. One major reason is that moving data between memory and the processor has become a major limitation on AI performance. energia_materiais.titulo: Scientists find hidden materials that could improve batteries and solar fuels
energia_materiais.resumo: Scientists have uncovered a hidden world of “in-between” materials that briefly form as chemical ingredients are heated, revealing structures that conventional methods can miss. Among the discoveries is a previously unknown form of bismuth vanadate, a material widely studied for using sunlight to help produce clean hydrogen. The new version has a different atomic structure and interacts with light in a strikingly different way, potentially opening new possibilities for solar fuels, catalysts, and electronics.

energia_materiais.titulo: Temporary melting liquid could help build better perovskite solar cells and LEDs
energia_materiais.resumo: A team co-led by researchers at the University of California San Diego has developed a new way to make perovskite solar cells—a promising next-generation solar technology—more efficient and durable. By creating a temporary liquid while the material crystallizes, researchers were able to grow perovskite crystals that were larger, more uniform and contained fewer defects.

energia_materiais.titulo: High rare earth demand could complicate Europe's offshore wind ambitions
energia_materiais.resumo: Wind turbines, devices that can convert energy from the wind into electricity, do not burn fuel during operation and could thus reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Despite their possible environmental advantages, building these devices depends heavily on the mines and factories supplying the metals they are made of.

energia_materiais.titulo: Global consensus sets testing guidelines for solar cells harvesting indoor light
energia_materiais.resumo: Indoor photovoltaics (iPV) converts light from LEDs and fluorescent lamps found in homes and buildings into electricity, offering a route to self-powered sensors, remote controls, wearables and the tens of billions of connected devices expected to make up the internet of things (IoT). Whereas solar cells have had clear standards for measuring and reporting performance and stability outdoors under the sun, their use under indoor lighting has lacked a comparable consensus baseline standard.

ciberseguranca.titulo: O que é root no Android?
ciberseguranca.resumo: Muitos usuários do Android consideram fazer root para ter mais controle sobre o celular e acessar recursos que ficam limitados pelas fabricantes ou operadoras. O procedimento costuma ser procurado por quem quer remover aplicativos pré-instalados, personalizar a interface ou modificar funções do sistema que não estão disponíveis na configuração de fábrica. Embora o Android tenha componentes de código aberto, as fabricantes aplicam restrições e permissões para proteger o sistema e os dados do usuário. O root altera essas limitações e concede privilégios elevados de administração, conhecidos como acesso de superusuário. Esse acesso abre novas possibilidades de personalização, mas também modifica o modelo de segurança do Android. Por isso, fazer root envolve riscos que devem ser considerados, como perda de suporte da fabricante, exposição maior a malwares e a possibilidade de inutilizar o aparelho em caso de erro durante o processo. ciberseguranca.titulo: Celulares Android baratos já chegam ao Brasil com vírus de fábrica
ciberseguranca.resumo: Uma campanha de malware está infectando celulares Android de baixo custo antes mesmo de os aparelhos chegarem às mãos dos consumidores . A ameaça, identificada pela empresa de cibersegurança Bitdefender, já foi detectada em milhares de dispositivos de mais de 150 países, incluindo o Brasil. Batizado de Midnight Mimosa , o malware fica instalado diretamente no firmware dos aparelhos, software responsável pelo funcionamento básico do celular. Dessa forma, os criminosos conseguem executar atividades maliciosas sem que a vítima precise baixar aplicativos ou clicar em links suspeitos. Segundo a pesquisa da Bitdefender, divulgada na quinta-feira (8), as infecções foram identificadas principalmente em celulares baratos equipados com processadores MediaTek, incluindo modelos de fabricantes menos conhecidos e imitações de smartphones populares. O Brasil aparece entre os sete países com maior número de detecções, atrás de México, França, Itália, Estados Unidos e Alemanha . A empresa não informou quantos dispositivos foram afetados especificamente no mercado brasileiro. Como funciona o vírus que vem instalado no celular?
